about: God is addressed as the strength of those who hope in Him. Recalling the strength given to Gregory VII to defend the Church’s freedom, the prayer asks for courage to overcome all that opposes the community.

s01.translation: God, strength of those who hope in You, You strengthened blessed Gregory, Your confessor and pontiff, with steadfast courage to defend the Church’s freedom. Grant that, by his example and intercession, we may courageously overcome everything that opposes us. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

alignments.gloss: strength of those who hope in You
to overcome courageously everything that opposes us
who lives and reigns with You
in the unity of the Holy Spirit

w005.explanation: God is the strength on which those who hope in Him depend.

w012.explanation: “Pontiff” is Gregory’s title as pope in this prayer.

w014.explanation: The defense of the Church’s freedom is the purpose for which Gregory was strengthened.

w018.explanation: The courage given to Gregory is marked by constancy, the steadfastness needed for that defense.

w027.explanation: The petition embraces everything that opposes the community. It asks for courage in overcoming those obstacles.

w046.explanation: The word “God” refers to the Son, who lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
